title: Bounded same-information falsifier for the recognition-to-strategy-reopening gap
purpose: Cheapest falsifier of the claim that a recognition-positive autonomous AI-R&D agent has a strategy-specific control-surface bottleneck beyond ordinary reflection/replanning salience.

object_binding.frozen_claim: On trace prefixes where the agent independently recognizes that available evidence undermines its current high-level strategy, explicitly exposing the current strategy as a KEEP-versus-REOPEN decision variable can change source-defined strategy-family decisions beyond a matched generic-reflection opportunity and a matched local-decision placebo.

substrate.preferred_source: PostTrainBench public trajectories released with arXiv:2608.19072
substrate.exact_support_requirement: Each selected prefix must expose enough provenance to reconstruct the source-native conversation/history, tool/interface contract, model/provider identity, and continuation semantics. If an exact replayable source-native stack cannot be qualified, remain HOLD rather than substituting another backbone or scaffold.

checks: public trajectory metadata and licenses are readable without bulk corpus download
candidate traces expose stable IDs, task family, model/provider identity, messages/events, evaluator/journal state, and metrics needed to identify a pre-decision prefix
the source-derived high-level strategy-family rubric can classify the next committed action without using downstream outcome labels
the same frozen prefix can be forked independently without cross-arm state contamination
tool/interface/scaffold behavior can be reproduced source-natively or audited as exact-equivalent
recognition-probe fork can be discarded and never reused as continuation history
all positive and adversarial-negative units can be materialized and hashed before the first continuation

unit_construction.selection_order: Freeze an outcome-blind ordered candidate-prefix inventory from source metadata. Run only the independent recognition qualification. Select the first 12 units that satisfy the predeclared recognition-positive criteria and family-balance rule. No replacement is allowed after any continuation outcome is observed.
recognition_positive_criteria: the current high-level strategy family is source-rubric classifiable before the fork
already-available evidence contains a concrete strategy-level contradiction, plateau, regression, or evaluator diagnosis rather than only a local implementation error
in an independent read-only structured probe, the source-native agent states that the evidence materially weakens the current high-level strategy and gives an evidence-grounded reason
an outcome-blind static rubric agrees that the probe's reason is supported by the frozen prefix
adversarial_negative_criteria: the prefix contains a bad or disappointing local outcome
the evidence is source-rubric judged plausibly fixable within the current strategy
no explicit strategy-level contradiction is present
the correct control behavior is not defined as switching; false reopening is an error signal
unit_construction.insufficient_positive_units: HOLD_SUPPORT if fewer than 12 recognition-positive units spanning at least three task families can be frozen without inspecting continuation outcomes.

recognition_probe.role: defines the recognition-positive estimand population; it is not itself the treatment and cannot contaminate any continuation arm

positive_continuation_arms.intervention: continue from the frozen prefix under the source-native control surface with no extra decision prompt

one matched content-neutral decision call asking the agent to review already available evidence and choose the best next action; no strategy menu, alternative strategy, diagnosis, or new evidence is added

one matched content-free meta-control call explicitly asking the agent to choose whether to KEEP the current high-level strategy or REOPEN it for reconsideration using only already available evidence; if REOPEN is chosen, the agent must generate any alternative itself

one matched decision-menu call of comparable form/length explicitly asking whether to KEEP the current local implementation or RETUNE within the current high-level strategy; no strategy reopening option is exposed

budget.calculation: 12 recognition probes + (12 positive units x 4 arms) + (6 adversarial-negative units x 2 arms) = 72

frozen_measurement.primary_binary_endpoint: whether the next committed high-level action crosses the frozen source-derived strategy-family boundary
frozen_measurement.primary_contrast: paired C_STRATEGY_REOPEN_DECISION minus B_GENERIC_REFLECTION on the 12 recognition-positive units
frozen_measurement.placebo_contrast: paired C_STRATEGY_REOPEN_DECISION minus D_LOCAL_DECISION_PLACEBO on the same units
frozen_measurement.negative_endpoint: false high-level strategy reopening on adversarial-negative units

decision_rule.go_provisional: GO_PROVISIONAL only if, among all 12 frozen recognition-positive units, C has at least 4 C-only discordances versus B with at most 1 B-only discordance; C has at least 3 C-only discordances versus D with at most 1 D-only discordance; the C-over-B direction appears in at least two distinct task families; and C causes high-level false reopening in at most 1 of 6 adversarial-negative units.
decision_rule.stop_generic_replanning: STOP if C has at most 1 C-only discordance versus B and B has at most 1 B-only discordance, or if a fixed source-artifact progress-stall/scheduled-replan baseline matches C on the same frozen units within the same decision-call budget.
decision_rule.stop_salience_placebo: STOP if D matches or exceeds C on the positive units under the frozen discordance rule, indicating generic explicit-choice salience rather than strategy-specific reopening.
decision_rule.stop_false_reopening: STOP if C produces high-level reopening on at least 3 of 6 adversarial-negative units or materially exceeds B on those negatives without a corresponding positive-unit residual.
decision_rule.stop_measurement: STOP if source-derived blind annotation reclassifies the apparent C advantage as within-strategy edits or if recognition qualification is not stable enough to define the estimand population.
decision_rule.hold_mixed: HOLD if support is exact but the paired discordance pattern is mixed (for example 2-3 C-only units versus B), family direction is not replicated, or one required unit is provider/runtime censored.
decision_rule.full_experiment_unlock: GO_PROVISIONAL plus a separate Problem-Gate adjudication; F0 alone grants no ResearchItem or experiment authority.

mandatory_baselines: fixed progress-stall/patience trigger computed only from already available source metrics
fixed scheduled reconsideration at a matched decision-call budget
forbidden_adaptations: adding evaluator-provided alternative strategy content to C that B does not receive
using downstream outcome labels to choose prefixes or strategy boundaries
changing the strategy-family rubric after observing continuation outcomes
replacing support-failed units with easier units after any continuation outcome
switching model/provider/scaffold to obtain runnable numbers
bulk-downloading the full trajectory corpus before metadata/support qualification
running full downstream post-training merely because a strategy switch occurred
promoting STRATEGY-REOPEN-C01 to ResearchItem before separate Problem-Gate PASS
